method.selection_rule: |Hedges g| >= 0.5, bootstrap direction >= 0.80, sensitivity >= 2/3, plus q <= 0.20 or stronger effect/stability
method.short_corner_definition: first delivery length <= 15 StatsBomb pitch units
method.shot_rate_definition: share of corner sequences containing at least one team shot
method.comparison_baseline: selected team previous chronological window; competition-wide routine baseline is not present in this source bundle
method.stability_definition: direction under nearby recent-window sizes, with minimum routine sample
method.dead_ball_taxonomy: corner, wide attacking free kick, indirect attacking free kick near the box, direct free kick; other restarts are architecture-only
method.dead_ball_free_kick_note: Free-kick categories are event-location buckets, not referee-certified direct/indirect labels.

comparisons.label: Expected goals
comparisons.definition: Sum of StatsBomb shot xG for the team.

comparisons.label: Final-third entries
comparisons.definition: Completed passes or carries crossing from x < 80 to x >= 80.

comparisons.label: Box entries
comparisons.definition: Completed passes or carries entering x >= 102 and 18 <= y <= 62.

comparisons.label: Progressive actions
comparisons.definition: Completed passes or carries gaining at least 15 metres in x.
comparisons.suppression_reason: negligible standardized effect, unstable bootstrap direction, window sensitivity, weak multiple-comparison evidence

comparisons.label: Build-up exits
comparisons.definition: Completed passes or carries starting at x <= 40 and ending at x >= 60.
comparisons.suppression_reason: negligible standardized effect, unstable bootstrap direction, window sensitivity, weak multiple-comparison evidence

comparisons.label: High regains
comparisons.definition: Ball Recovery or Interception events recorded at x >= 80.
